headline: Tesla already sells the Cybercab: it costs more than a Mazda3 and yet you must pay a subscription to use it
summary: Tesla is selling its Cybercab, which costs more than a Mazda3. Buyers must pay a subscription to use it, and it operates only in some areas.
why: Tesla is a US electric-vehicle and energy company whose valuation depends heavily on autonomous driving and robotaxi plans. Pricing and service terms for new vehicles signal how quickly those plans can generate revenue.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: The Cybercab launch and its subscription model bear directly on Tesla's autonomous-vehicle revenue plans.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Tesla ya vende el Cybercab: cuesta más que un Mazda3 y aun así debes pagar una suscripción para usarlo
